units: Ber. 5ᵃ (ref. to Ps. XXXIX, 3) אין ט׳ אלא וכ׳ under good the Torah is meant. Ib. 60ᵇ זו מדה ט׳ this refers to a good dispensation; a. v. fr.—יום טוב (abbr. י״ט) festival.
Bets. I, 1; a. fr.—כי טוב (ref. to Gen. I, 4) day-time.

<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 5:3">Ber. V, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Berakhot 33b:17">33ᵇ</cite>) <he>על טוב וכ׳</he> thy name be praised for the good (thou doest).—<he>זכור לַטּוֹב</he>, v. <he>עין טובה</he>—.<cite ref="G00467"><he>זָכַר</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="P00601"><he>עַיִן</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>טוֹבְים</he>, f. <he>טוֹבוֹת</he>. Ber. l. c. (34ᵃ, omitt. in Mish.) <he>האומר יברכוך ט׳</he> he who says in prayer, The good praise thee. Ib. IX, 2 <he>בשורות ט׳</he>, v. <cite ref="B01352"><he>בְּשוֹרָה</he></cite>; a. v. fr.—V. <cite ref="I00112"><he>טוֹבָה</he></cite>.
Tosef. Shek. II, 16 בני ט׳ of noble descent; a. fr.—טוֹבֵי העיר representatives of the town.
